hooks.command: if command -v ast-index >/dev/null 2>&1; then if ast-index stats >/dev/null 2>&1; then ast-index update >/dev/null 2>&1 || true; echo '{"hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"SessionStart","additionalContext":"ast-index: index updated"}}'; else ast-index rebuild >/dev/null 2>&1 || true; echo '{"hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"SessionStart","additionalContext":"ast-index: index rebuilt"}}'; fi; else echo '{"hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"SessionStart","additionalContext":"ast-index: not found"}}'; fi
echo '{"hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"SessionStart","additionalContext":"REQUIRED SESSION START to read rules from CLAUDE.md. Show user a summary of these rules"}}'

cmd=$(jq -r '.tool_input.command // empty'); if echo "$cmd" | grep -qE '(^|[ ;&|`])git[[:space:]]+commit '; then branch=$(git branch --show-current 2>/dev/null); if [ "$branch" = "master" ]; then printf 'BLOCKED: git commit on master is forbidden.

Recovery (no commits yet on master):
  git checkout -b feat/YYYY-MM-DD-name

Recovery (commits already on master, not yet pushed):
  git stash                                           # save uncommitted work
  git checkout -b feat/YYYY-MM-DD-name                 # branch carries the commits
  git checkout master                                  # back to master
  git reset --soft origin/master && git restore --staged .   # rewind without losing work
  git checkout feat/YYYY-MM-DD-name && git stash pop   # resume on feature branch

Never use git reset --hard. Full procedure: AGENTS.md > Workflow > Recovery.
' >&2; exit 2; fi; fi

cmd=$(jq -r '.tool_input.command // empty'); if echo "$cmd" | grep -qE '(^|[ ;&|`])git[[:space:]]+commit '; then if ! err=$(bash "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR/scripts/gen-roadmap.sh" 2>&1 >/dev/null); then printf 'BLOCKED: scripts/gen-roadmap.sh failed:
%s

Fix the error and re-run git commit.
' "$err" >&2; exit 2; fi; git -C "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR" add ROADMAP.md 2>/dev/null || true; fi

cmd=$(jq -r '.tool_input.command // empty'); if echo "$cmd" | grep -qE '(^|[ ;&|`])git[[:space:]]+commit\b'; then bash "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR/scripts/update-ast-index.sh" >/dev/null 2>&1 || true; fi; exit 0
jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // .tool_response.filePath // empty' | { read -r f && [[ "$f" == *.rs ]] && cargo fmt --quiet --manifest-path "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR/Cargo.toml"; } || true

jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // .tool_response.filePath // empty' | { read -r f; if [[ "$f" == *.rs && "$f" != *"/tests/"* && "$f" != *"/examples/"* ]] && [ -f "$f" ]; then hits=$(awk '/^\s*#\[cfg\(test\)\]/{flag=1; next} flag && /^\s*mod\s+[a-zA-Z_]+\s*\{/{intest=1; depth=1; flag=0; next} intest{depth+=gsub(/\{/,"{")-gsub(/\}/,"}"); if(depth<=0){intest=0}; next} /\.unwrap\(\)|\.expect\(|panic!\(/ && !/^\s*///{print FILENAME":"NR": "$0}' "$f"); if [ -n "$hits" ]; then printf '
[panic-gate] panicking calls in production code (outside #[cfg(test)]):
%s
[panic-gate] verify each is genuinely unrecoverable — see AGENTS.md library safety idioms; substitution table in .claude/agents/self-review.md §4.
' "$hits" >&2; fi; fi; } || true

jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // .tool_response.filePath // empty' | { read -r f; case "$f" in */ai-docs/plans/INDEX.md|ai-docs/plans/INDEX.md) printf '\n[roadmap-sync] ai-docs/plans/INDEX.md was edited — run `./scripts/gen-roadmap.sh` and stage the regenerated ROADMAP.md in the SAME commit. CI fails the "ROADMAP sync" check otherwise (see ai-docs/learnings.md 2026-05-14 ROADMAP entry).\n' >&2 ;; esac; } || true

cmd=$(jq -r '.tool_input.command // empty'); if echo "$cmd" | grep -qE '(^|[ ;&|`])git[[:space:]]+push\b' && ! echo "$cmd" | grep -qE 'gh[[:space:]]+pr[[:space:]]+create'; then branch=$(git branch --show-current 2>/dev/null); if [ -n "$branch" ] && [ "$branch" != "master" ]; then pr_json=$(gh pr view --json number,state,url 2>/dev/null); if [ -n "$pr_json" ]; then state=$(echo "$pr_json" | jq -r '.state // empty'); number=$(echo "$pr_json" | jq -r '.number // empty'); if [ "$state" = "OPEN" ]; then printf '\n[pr-sync] open PR #%s on %s — re-read body with `gh pr view %s --json title,body` and sync via `gh pr edit` if scope/names/ACs drifted (AGENTS.md "PR body sync after every push"). Exception: this push immediately preceded `gh pr create`.\n' "$number" "$branch" "$number" >&2; fi; fi; fi; fi

cmd=$(jq -r '.tool_input.command // empty'); if echo "$cmd" | grep -qE 'git[[:space:]]+add' && echo "$cmd" | grep -qE 'ai-docs/plans/INDEX\.md'; then staged=$(git diff --cached --name-only 2>/dev/null); if echo "$staged" | grep -qx 'ai-docs/plans/INDEX.md' && ! echo "$staged" | grep -qx 'ROADMAP.md'; then printf '\n[roadmap-stage] INDEX.md staged without ROADMAP.md — run bash scripts/gen-roadmap.sh and git add ROADMAP.md in the SAME commit (AGENTS.md learnings 2026-05-14 ROADMAP entry; 3 occurrences).\n' >&2; fi; fi
